reason: The numbers are fair: worst case EUR 3,000 for 5 qualified meetings is EUR 600 a meeting, and if they miss I only lose EUR 1,500. But the new country is next year, so I would take the free 15 companies now and not pay anything this month.
objection: My team has no time for this, and I do not believe 3 hours in total. Also 'qualified meeting' with a decision-maker is not a deal, and a logistics case with 45 meetings tells me nothing about a wholesaler selling into a new market.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 sample companies are real buyers I do not already know, and the past client in my niche tells me the meetings turned into orders, I would start the Sprint in Q1, timed to the market entry.
